oldBrowser: This browser is too old to display the map.
loadErr: The data could not be loaded. Please try again later.
mapAria: Map of rooftop PV installations across mainland France, aggregated on a square grid
lead: {n} installations detected on aerial imagery ({gwp} GWp estimated), aggregated on square cells of 2 km or more. Drag the slider: cell size and colours are recomputed on the fly.
resHint: Each cell groups {k} × {k} INSEE 1 km cells ({area} km²).
resHintOne: A single cell covers the whole country: you read the national value (mean or total).
tilesErr: Map tiles could not be loaded (no connection, or refused by the tile server).
advHint: Cross PV with an explanatory variable (INSEE, power classes), filter by power class and by reliability, colour scale, opacity.
clsHint: Filters the number of installations and the capacity of the mapped variable. The classes are also available as explanatory variables.

scaleHint.log: Colours orders of magnitude: useful when a few cells concentrate most of the value.
scaleHint.lin: Range between the 2nd and 98th percentiles, values beyond are saturated.
scaleHint.quant: Each colour covers as many cells: shows the ranking, not the gaps.

scatterAria: Density of cells in the plane of the two variables
rhoTail: over {n} cells{sample}. Rank correlation: it describes an association, not a causal link.
exportHint: Exported data are those of the displayed map (resolution, variables and detections kept).
noteGrey: grey: ratio not computed (denominator too small)
tipOne: A single cell: the whole country
thrNote: Computed on cells with at least {thr} {what}.

rev.label: Income (cumulated living standard)
rev.perLab: per million euros of cumulated living standard
